contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
[IMP NER]O CAESAR AVG [P MAX TR P P P]

Complete Roman copper alloy As, coin of Nero (AD54-68). Obverse, bust of Nero facing right with part of legend [IMP NER]O CAESAR AVG [P MAX TR P P P]. Reverse, winged victory holding shield advancing left, some indication of SPQR inscription on shield, flanked with S C. As a copper alloy coin of Nero it likely belongs to the last four years of his reign AD64-68. (Reece and James 2000). Diameter: 27.5mm, Weight: 9.29g. Reference: Reece, R. and James, S. 2000. Identifying Roman Coins. Spink, London
